description_en: Creates an electricity load forecasting task
description_zh: 创建用电负荷预测任务
kebab_example: aliyun brain-industrial create-load-forecast-job --device-type electricityMeter --history-data RunTime=2025-12-12_00:00:00 Value=1.0 --freq FIFTEEN_MIN --duration 1 --system-type load --run-date 2025-12-12 --time-zone Asia/Shanghai --model-version latest --business-key stationA --forecast-horizon DAY_AHEAD --data-mode FULL --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLoadForecastJob

parameters.help_en:
The device type. The device types supported by each systemType are as follows:
System type: Device type 

load: electricityMeter -- mains electricity meter 
hvac: gateway-hvac -- air conditioner 
flexible: electricityMeter -- lighting electricity meter 
charge: gateway-charging -- charging station
parameters.help_zh:
设备类型，每个systemType支持的设备类型有：
系统类型：设备类型 

load:  electricityMeter --市电电表 
hvac: gateway-hvac --空调 
flexible: electricityMeter --照明电表 
charge：gateway-charging --充电桩
parameters.name: device_type

fields.help_en: The timestamp at every {freq} minutes, in the "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss" format. The data frequency must be aligned with the freq field
fields.help_zh: 每{freq}分钟，"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"， 数据频率需与freq字段对齐
fields.name: run_time

parameters.help_en: The historical load data. 90 days of historical data is required
parameters.help_zh: 历史负荷，需要90天的历史数据
parameters.name: history_data

parameters.help_en:
The data frequency. Default value: FIFTEEN_MIN. The value must be consistent with the data frequency of historyData. Valid values:

FIFTEEN_MIN: 15 minutes
FIVE_MIN: 5 minutes
ONE_HOUR: 1 hour
ONE_DAY: 1 day
parameters.help_zh:
默认15min；需要与historyData的数据频率一致；枚举值：

FIFTEEN_MIN: 15分钟
FIVE_MIN: 5分钟
ONE_HOUR: 1小时
ONE_DAY: 1天
parameters.name: freq

parameters.help_en:
The forecast duration in days, starting from the run date (inclusive).

Optional. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
从运行日(含)开始, 预测时长（单位：天）。

非必填，默认1天
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
The system type. Valid values: 

load: mains electricity 
hvac: air conditioner 
flexible: lighting 
charge: charging station
parameters.help_zh:
系统类型，支持的系统类型有： 

load: 市电 
hvac: 空调 
flexible：照明 
charge：充电桩
parameters.name: system_type

parameters.help_en: The run date, accurate to the day, in the "yyyy-MM-dd" format
parameters.name: run_date

parameters.help_en: The time zone. Default value: Asia/Shanghai
parameters.name: time_zone

parameters.help_en: The version number of the model. Default value: latest
parameters.help_zh: 模型对应的版本号，默认为latest
parameters.name: model_version

parameters.help_en: The business key, such as the site name or ID
parameters.help_zh: 业务键，如场站名称编号等
parameters.name: business_key

parameters.help_en:
The forecast time horizon. Valid values:
DAY_AHEAD: day-ahead forecast
INTRADAY: intraday forecast
parameters.help_zh:
预测时间尺度，枚举值：
DAY_AHEAD：日前预测
INTRADAY：日内预测
parameters.name: forecast_horizon

parameters.help_en:
The data mode for this call. Valid values:
FULL: full data (uses only the data passed in this call).
INCREMENTAL: incremental data (automatically associates data from previous calls with the same BusinessKey)
parameters.help_zh:
本次调用的数据模式，枚举值：
FULL：全量数据（仅使用本次调用中传递的数据）
INCREMENTAL：增量数据（自动关联使用历史调用中相同BusinessKey的数据）
parameters.name: data_mode

Code.description_en:
The status code.

A value of 200 indicates success

Completed.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation is complete. Valid values: 
True: The current job has been completed. 
False: The current job is still running
Completed.description_zh:

False：当前Job还在执行中
